record.body:
## Interfaces

The handoff view, dashboard panel and engage skill read composer:idea. The score module no longer declares backlog-item or feedback. The live store holds 21 composer:idea records.

## Assumptions

R3, R4 and R7 are judged from the primary store read-only. The conversion script is not shipped.

## Invariants

Ids, subjects, bodies, payloads and history survive the rename. score does not import composer. Versions are unchanged.

## Conflicts

none
